purpose: Obtain the minimum traceable public evidence needed to adjudicate the existing Hero/Identity blocker without reopening accepted Massing.

hardGates.sameMemberMultiView: A candidate must show the same named member in at least one independent side/depth or rear/roof-back view; front-only evidence is insufficient.
hardGates.memberToOsmWay: A candidate must contain, or be traceably combined with, an authoritative north-oriented plan, survey, or unambiguous location evidence assigning 211-1 or 211-2 to exactly one of the nine accepted source ways.
hardGates.depthAndRear: For every member proposed for Hero geometry, the retained evidence set must cover side/depth and rear or roof-back with recorded observation direction.
hardGates.legalHeroLineage: Only a future Hero derived from accepted Massing SHA ab05b4ec... with member, way, origin, orientation and collision semantics recorded can enter MCP2; the old four-villa Hero cannot be reused.

acceptanceMatrix.passWhen: post URL, author/display name, observed date, post date if present, and every used image or frame are recorded
211-1 or 211-2 is explicit, or a compound view has independent binding evidence
one named member is assigned to one sourceWayId in acceptedSourceWays without interpolation
the same bound member has a side/depth and rear or roof-back view with observation direction
a future candidate records accepted Massing SHA, sourceWayId, member, placement and collision semantics

publicAndUserPhotoBoundary.publicImages: Public posts are supplemental traceable evidence only and cannot be labeled as user-taken photographs.
publicAndUserPhotoBoundary.userPhotos: No user-supplied 211 original is currently asserted by this contract; if later supplied, retain its original path and distinguish it from public material.
publicAndUserPhotoBoundary.noSubstitution: Do not use public images to fill an absent user-photo slot, and do not use a thumbnail or generated runtime image as real-world evidence.

stopImmediatelyOn: any uncertainty that an interaction changes account state
prohibited: likes, follows, comments, saves or messages
evasion, simulation or bypass of platform detection

postSearchDisposition.reasonableSearchExhaustion: All four query groups were attempted under the safety limits, each opened result was logged, and no admissible combination closes all hard gates.
postSearchDisposition.beforeExhaustion: Keep current Massing-only runtime; do not disable or alter runtime, registry, assets, Recovery/Hold, or shared status.
postSearchDisposition.afterExhaustion: Main window may propose a runtime-disable candidate for this building only. It is not automatic and requires an explicit retained-file audit.
postSearchDisposition.retention: All existing GLB, Blend, generator, evidence, screenshots, tests, Recovery/Hold and rejected-candidate records remain permanently preserved.

allowedFutureWork: future valid Hero only after every hard gate passes
prohibitedHere: tree, decoration, full-map or extra-building work
